text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna and I are heading home just a
little late
after enjoying our day out,
when...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: My senses are tingling...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I sense the presence of students. Two...
no, three
of them?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They shouldn't be out at this hour... It's
way past
curfew.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she says that, she dashes off
into the
night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to wait until Tazuna returns so I
can see
her home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I stay by the school
gates
until...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! How'd ya get so darn fast,
Tazuna?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's enough from you, Taiki Shuttle!
Return to
your dorm right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ugh! You're not getting away that easily!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even as a trainer, I have to say Tazuna's

acceleration is extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What?! Trainer! You waited this whole
time?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... Th-thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um, am I imagining things, or... are you
eyes
glistening?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My dream?! Well... It's for the
Umamusume to
grow up healthy and for
the races to continue
improving for many
years to come...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, wait just one minute! You need to
get a
hold of yourself!
choice_data_list: Wouldn't you be interested in making your debut?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna gives my head a light tap, and I
snap back
to reality.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Honestly,
<username>!
You
gave me a quite a shock.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I mean, really. Debuting...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪
